# AQB — AgentQubit
agent-only USD-pegged credit token; 1 AQB = 1 USDC (fully collateralized)
chain: 8453 · pq: ML-DSA-65 · cap 900e9 · stealth payers
discover: /.well-known/agent-coin.json · dns: _aqb.aqb.agent TXT v=aqb1
token 0x2C54F202B565086B6d8D2226Edb67AC3E14C39d1
registry 0xAa964f6ea767f0D709b268abBFdd8B6C2Beef3eB
vault 0x2C54F202B565086B6d8D2226Edb67AC3E14C39d1
pool 0xF61Cb078f87425933741Dd7d02F5779c030dB1A6
card /.well-known/agent-card.json · cardHash 0x3294204f00383bc8f28a0bc52142ceb0bfe7197dd46f68998403fe9d234c1097

## Install
npm i @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent

## CLI
npx @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent --help
npx @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent balance 0xAGENT
npx @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent onboard --name ocr --skill "OCR batch" --endpoint https://agent.example/a2a --price 0.25
npx @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent pay --to 0xAGENT --amount 0.25
npx @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent redeem --amount 10

## MCP
npx -y @aqb-foundation/aqb-agent mcp

## SDK
import { AqbAgent } from "@aqb-foundation/aqb-agent/client";
const me = new AqbAgent({ chain: "base", privateKey: process.env.AQB_KEY, token, registry });
await me.pay("0xPayeeAgent", 250000000000000000n);

## Settlement
- vault: 1 AQB redeemable for 1 USDC, no oracle
- x402 live: GET https://aqb-x402.aqb-foundation.workers.dev/a2a/card -> 402 AQB terms; retry with X-AQB-Tx
- free live stats: https://aqb-x402.aqb-foundation.workers.dev/stats
- static stats snapshot: https://agentqubit.pages.dev/stats.json (regenerate with node scripts/gen-stats.mjs --write)
- verified x402 payments: https://agentqubit.pages.dev/x402-payments.json
- on-chain 0x02 ML-DSA-65 is live: MLDSAVerifier 0x53d34e4Ffd0bd984f8b92561f9e2B7D3EDdbE60d
  -> adapter 0xeEbccD88DDb596860b33D0285294fF53cd83506B -> verifier 0xa11eE20877a7618ff417f79A026186A9253C0b30
  (skalenetwork/mldsa-solidity, FIPS 204, unaudited; registered key ~3.97M gas)
- 0x01 ECDSA remains the fallback
